plugins.name: EPG & Sports Editor
plugins.description: Create transformed virtual copies of EPG sources using per-source, per-field regex and find/replace rules. Channels are auto-reassigned and kept in sync after every refresh. Generates fill EPG schedules for channels with no EPG data, and a Sports Editor with live-schedule matching (93 leagues) for auto-synced sports channels.
plugins.author: jstevenscl
